description: Connects pathogen proteins to human diseases using PHI-base curated pathogen–host experiments and disease annotations.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting the relationship; PHI denotes PHI-base.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time of the most recent change to the relationship.

source_contributions.scope: Human-host records (host taxonomy ID 9606) with an existing pathogen-species Organism, an existing UniProt Protein, and a resolved Disease annotation. All mutant-phenotype categories are included.
source_contributions.description: Evidence from experiments supporting the same Protein–Disease pair is combined into deduplicated lists. Disease annotations are matched by exact names or exact ontology synonyms, or by human-reviewed contextual mappings. Unresolved annotations contribute no relationship. Experimental tissues and cell lines describe the model, not a clinical diagnosis. Nonempty source placeholders are preserved in evidence values.

properties.name: mutant_phenotype
properties.description: Mutant phenotypes reported in the supporting experiments; all source phenotype categories are retained.
properties.notes: independent value sets, not parallel per-experiment arrays

properties.name: tissue_type
properties.description: Tissues reported in the supporting experiments.
properties.notes: independent value sets, not parallel per-experiment arrays; [] if all contributing values are blank

properties.name: experimental_evidence
properties.description: Experimental evidence reported by PHI-base for the supporting experiments.
properties.notes: independent value sets, not parallel per-experiment arrays; [] if all contributing values are blank

properties.name: pathogen_ncbi_strain_id
properties.description: Pathogen strain taxonomy identifiers reported in the supporting experiments.
properties.notes: independent value sets, not parallel per-experiment arrays; [] if all contributing values are blank
